ns2:course.label: Design Drawing II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of ARTD 225. Drawing and rendering techniques for industrial designers using mixed media with emphasis on quick perspective product delineation. Integration of hand and computer methods of communication. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in industrial design or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in industrial design or consent of instructor.
